scope: decentralized Registry source-plan and independent OS-executor contract
verified_behaviors: Registry schedules bind a canonical source-plan digest and explicit source kind independently from the OS executor
stable source-kind codes cover DirectPeer, CommunitySeed, CarrierPeer, HttpsMirror and LocalImport
stable executor codes cover AndroidUidt, IosBackgroundUrlSession and ForegroundNative without naming HTTPS as an executor
an active schedule rejects replay with a different source kind, source-plan digest, request fingerprint or executor

legacy ABI 9 through 11 schedule JSON migrates the old descriptor field to source-plan digest and foreground HTTPS execution to optional HttpsMirror plus ForegroundNative without granting content authority
Android persisted UIDT extras carry and validate the same source-plan digest and source-kind code
the C/JNI boundary exposes only bounded digests and codes and embeds no URL, path, credential, provider handle or central endpoint
HttpsMirror is one optional source kind and is not required Registry authority
limitations: this slice defines and tests the provider-neutral durable contract but implements no production provider response executor
direct-peer/community-seed and local-import byte adapters remain open and must be first-class before an optional HTTPS mirror/carrier fallback
iOS bounded direct/background execution and optional background URLSession execution remain open
no production trust profile, provider endpoint, INTERNET permission, full-size Registry qualification or ReadyOffline claim is present
